Source heading: Intelligence That Stays Current With the Work
Source body:
Continuous Intelligence supports the operating cycle by keeping permitted context and analysis current as relevant signals, connected systems, workflows, events, and outcomes change.
Sense - Capture permitted signals and material change.
Understand - Reassess what the change means in context.
Recommend - Bring forward relevant options, implications, and uncertainty.
Act - Progress only within the authority already granted; pause where approval is required.
Observe - Compare what happened with the intended outcome.
Learn - Carry useful context and evidence into the next cycle.
This intelligence loop supports Clarity -> Capability -> Consistency. It does not replace the user-facing operating model, and it does not create new authority.

Source heading: Progression Does Not Equal Unlimited Authority
Source body:
Observe & Update - permitted context ingestion, synchronization, recalculation, status refresh, pattern detection, and analysis.
Progress Within Authorization - already-approved workflow steps, scheduled processing, defined notifications, and explicitly delegated work within scope.
Consequential Commitment - financial, legal, strategic, external, permission-changing, reputational, or irreversible actions pause for human approval unless that exact authority was explicitly delegated in advance under policy.
A lower authority band never silently becomes a higher one.
Review a Consequential Recommendation
Inspect the context, reasoning, progressed activity, governing permission, uncertainty, and required approval before the recommendation becomes consequential action.
SECTION 11
